model_system: chiral quasi-1D crystal (TaSe4)2I, comparing enantiomers A and B

key_params.CD-ARPES_geometry: incident light oblique in xz plane; chain axis aligned along x; surface normal in plane of incidence
key_params.target_observable: circular dichroism ARPES as proxy for OAM texture; comparison with spin-resolved ARPES and first-principles calculations

headline_claim: A p-wave orbital angular momentum texture with enantiomer-dependent sign reversal is observed in (TaSe4)2I, and the low-energy OAM polarization overwhelmingly exceeds the SAM polarization.
replication_difficulty: high - key evidence relies on synchrotron CD-/spin-resolved ARPES plus unspecified first-principles details not given in the excerpt.
